instruction.text: The UK has four capital cities for the four countries. Can you find the capital city of England on the map?

text.text: London is not only the capital city of England, but of the whole UK. It is the biggest and most populated city in the UK.

instruction.text: Spell the name of the capital city of Northern Ireland.

text.text: Belfast is well known for being the place where the Titanic was built.

atoms.word: B e l f a s t

instruction.text: Answer the questions using the map.

atoms.a: What is the name of the capital city of Scotland?

text: Edinburgh might be the capital of Scotland, but it is smaller and less populated than Glasgow - another Scottish city.

atoms.a: Which country is Cardiff the capital city of?

text: Cardiff only became the capital city of Wales in 1955, making it the youngest capital in the whole of Europe.

instruction.text: Can you remember where London is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: London is the capital of the biggest country in the UK.

instruction.text: Can you remember where Cardiff is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: Cardiff is on the south coast of the country it is in.

instruction.text: Can you remember where Belfast is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: Belfast is across the Irish Sea from three other countries.

instruction.text: Can you remember where Edinburgh is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: You have to drive a long way north to reach Edinburgh from London.
